title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors
description: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x1
episodes_data.description: The adventurers come across two wild Pokemon, Magnezone and Metagross. The rampaging Pokemon wreak havoc on a nearby town.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x2
episodes_data.description: Ash and company encounter a martial arts Pokemon trainer. He helps Ash and Weezil learn a new attack.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x3
episodes_data.description: The adventurers encounter Daniel, a scientific Pokemon trainer. Daniel and Ash compete in a Pokemon Marathon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x4
episodes_data.description: Dawn enters the Daybreak Town Pokemon contest. A rival's Pokemon reminds Dawn of a painful childhood experience.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x5
episodes_data.description: Dawn competes in the finals at the Daybreak Town Contest for her fifth ribbon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x6
episodes_data.description: Ash and company encounter Barry and Paul. Barry and Ash have a battle that's interrupted by Team Rocket with a new plan to take their Pokemon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x7
episodes_data.description: Piplup after getting hit by Drago Meteor one too many times by Ash's Gible, Piplup gets frustrated when the adventurers try to boost Gible's confidence, and decides to run away.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x8
episodes_data.description: Ash and company arrive at the Sunny Shore Gym. Where they find Voltner, the Gym Leader, has given up on battling.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x9
episodes_data.description: Ash's gym battle with Volkner is interrupted when Team Rocket steals Sunnyshore Tower.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x10
episodes_data.description: Dawn's mother is supposed to teach a beginner's Pokemon Coordinator class, but gets called away to judge a nearby contest. The young adventurers teach her class.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x11
episodes_data.description: As our heroes prepare for Dawn's entry into the Grand Festival and Ash's rematch with Gym Leader Volkner, they meet a mysterious girl with a sick Shaymin who needs help!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x12
episodes_data.description: As our heroes continue their Sinnoh region journey, they come across a determined, upbeat Pokémon Ranger on a mission to capture a rare Heatran!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x13
episodes_data.description: The adventurers meet Roland a young trainer who falls victim to Team Rocket's latest ploy. They also meet Bertha, one of the Elite Four.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x14
episodes_data.description: A princess asks Dawn to trade places for a day, so that the princess may compete in a Pokemon contest.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x15
episodes_data.description: Dawn begins training her new acquired Togekiss.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x16
episodes_data.description: The adventurers meet Narissa. A trainer who has a lot to learn about Pokemon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x17
episodes_data.description: Contestants arrive for the Grand Festival. Rivals and friends gather for the competition. One competitor makes an unexpected early exit.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x18
episodes_data.description: Day 2 of the Grand Festival. Dawn faces off against Ursala.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x19
episodes_data.description: Semi-final battles at the Grand Festival. With Nando vs Zoey. Then Dawn vs Jessilina.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x20
episodes_data.description: The Grand Festival finals. Dawn vs Zooey in the for title of Top Coordinator.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x21
episodes_data.description: Meowth meets and falls for a Glameowth. He ready to quit Team Rocket to be with her.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x22
episodes_data.description: Ash battles Voltner for his eighth and final badge.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x23
episodes_data.description: The adventurers miss their ship and have to wait a day before continuing their journey. They meet up with old friends. Dawn receives and unexpected invitation, and all of them start to contemplate the next part of their journey.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x24
episodes_data.description: The adventurers meet Buck, a treasure hunter, and help him on his latest venture.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x25
episodes_data.description: Ash asks Professor Oak to send him some of his old Pokemon for the upcoming competition. Team Rocket intercepts the Pokemon, now Ash must find and recover his Pokemon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x26
episodes_data.description: Round one of the Sinnoh League Championship. Ash vs Nando.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x27
episodes_data.description: Paul vs Barry in round 3.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x28
episodes_data.description: Ash vs Conway in Round 3.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x29
episodes_data.description: Quarter finals begin. Ash vs Paul, part 1.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x30
episodes_data.description: After Ash's early lead, Paul begins his counter attack.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x31
episodes_data.description: Ash vs Paul part 3. The battle of these arch-rivals concludes with the winner advancing to the semi-finals.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x32
episodes_data.description: Ash battles Tobias in the semi-finals. Tobia has only used his Darkrai in all his previous matches. Can Ash find a way to defeat Darkrai and what of the rest of Tobias's Pokemon?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x33
episodes_data.description: On the way back to Twin Leaf Town, several Pokemon are injured. With no Pokemon Doctor on board, Brock does everything he can to help the Pokemon until support arrives.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 13 DP Sinnoh League Victors 13x34
episodes_data.description: Ash and Brock spend the night at Dawn's house as they prepare for their return to their respective homes. It's a time of farewell. Brock makes a surprise announcement. The three friends part to pursue their own individual dreams.
